brief.headline: Push for ₹0.65–0.80/pc on caps (market says fair price is lower at volume) and ask for 15-day faster payment to free up ₹2.77 L cash

priceAsk.summary: Ask for ₹0.65–0.80/pc on the 28 mm induction-wad PP cap
priceAsk.basis: Market asking price for this cap is ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc; market verdict says MARKET-FAIR with modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume or looser spec — so our target sits at that lower end

paymentTermAsk.summary: Ask them to move payment from 30 days after receipt to 15 days after receipt
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Cutting 15 days off the payment cycle frees up ₹2.77 L cash for us

brief.financialLeverage: Empire Industries publishes no financials, so we can't see their revenue, profit or how tight their cash is. That means we build our case on what we know: the market price data shows room to move lower, and we have five strong alternate suppliers lined up — including Manjushree (India's largest rigid-plastic converter, ₹2569.83 Cr revenue) and Mold-Tek (₹1010.97 Cr, profitable listed firm). With credible second sources ready, we can push confidently on price and terms without relying on their financial picture.

evidence.point: Market asking price for a 28 mm PP cap runs ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc
Market says MARKET-FAIR with modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume or looser spec
Cutting payment from 30 days to 15 days frees up cash for us
We spend ₹67.47 L annually with them on rigid plastic packaging
HDPE resin import unit value stands at 87.61 ₹/kg — a public benchmark for raw-material cost

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter (₹2569.83 Cr revenue, health score 65/100) — pharma bottles, caps, preforms; top second-source candidate

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader (₹1010.97 Cr revenue, health score 73/100) — pails, containers, pharma packaging; strong and profitable, a robust alternate for bottles and closures

alternates.name: Hitech Corporation Ltd
alternates.why: Listed moulded and blow-moulded packaging supplier (₹701.17 Cr revenue, health score 51/100) — broad capability across bottles and caps

risks: Empire Industries publishes no financials, so we fly blind on their cash position and stability — keep the tone firm but not aggressive until we qualify their resilience
The market price band is wide (₹0.55–1.20/pc) — if they push back, ask them to justify where they sit in that range and what volume or spec change gets us to the lower end
Our ₹67.47 L annual spend may be small to them (we don't know their revenue) — lead with the credible alternates (Manjushree, Mold-Tek) to show we can move volume if needed
Faster payment (15 days) is a concession for them — tie it explicitly to the price cut so it feels like a trade, not a giveaway
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We're reviewing all our rigid-packaging spend, and the market data shows room to bring the 28 mm cap price down to ₹0.65–0.80 at our volume — let's talk about how we get there and tighten up payment terms at the same time.
